description: This file implements the GatewayDiscovery class responsible for discovering network gateways via mDNS, DNS-SD, and unicast DNS queries, including service resolution and DNS record parsing within an Android application.

classes.name: GatewayDiscovery
classes.description: Manages discovery and resolution of network gateways using Android network services and DNS techniques, encapsulating discovery state and providing observable flow of gateways.

methods.name: startLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates local network service discovery via mDNS.

methods.name: stopLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Stops the local network service discovery.

methods.name: startUnicastDiscovery
methods.description: Begins unicast DNS discovery in a background coroutine.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a network service to obtain gateway endpoint information.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Updates the observable list of gateways and status text.

methods.name: buildStatusText
methods.description: Constructs a string summarizing current discovery status.

methods.name: stableId
methods.description: Generates a stable identifier for a service based on name and domain.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Normalizes service names by trimming and replacing whitespace.

methods.name: txt
methods.description: Extracts a string value from NsdServiceInfo attributes.

methods.name: txtInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from NsdServiceInfo attributes.

methods.name: txtBool
methods.description: Determines boolean attribute values from service info.

methods.name: refreshUnicast
methods.description: Performs DNS queries to discover gateways over wide-area networks.

methods.name: decodeInstanceName
methods.description: Decodes instance names from FQDNs relative to the service type.

methods.name: lookupUnicastMessage
methods.description: Performs DNS query for a given name and type over the network.

methods.name: records
methods.description: Retrieves section-specific DNS records from a message.

methods.name: recordsByName
methods.description: Organizes DNS records by name within a message.

methods.name: recordByName
methods.description: Finds the first record matching name and type.

methods.name: resolveHostFromMessage
methods.description: Resolves host IP address from DNS message records.

methods.name: rawQuery
methods.description: Performs a DNS query asynchronously over a specified network.

methods.name: txtValue
methods.description: Extracts string value associated with a key from TXT records.

methods.name: txtIntValue
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from TXT records by key.

methods.name: txtBoolValue
methods.description: Determines boolean value from TXT records by key.

methods.name: decodeDnsTxtString
methods.description: Decodes a DNS TXT string, handling UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: resolveHostUnicast
methods.description: Resolves hostname to IP address using unicast DNS queries.
